name: com.jadedbelles.util
description: Reusable Unity utilities for JadedBelles games. Currently ships a generic 2D grid system; more modules will land here as they get extracted from Xandria Gem Jam and other JadedBelles titles.

samples.description: A minimal example that creates a GridSystem2D, sets values, and prints them.
Prefab + wiring reference for the CharacterCustomization module. Drop into a scene, add a CharacterCustomization rig, and go.
